Subject: Re: Demo booking — shows wrong local time

Hi John — thanks for the screenshot, that helps. Sorry for the friction here.

Short explanation: Calendly auto-detects the visitor timezone and also adds a tz parameter to the confirmation invite, but certain combinations of browser/OS settings + our Calendly page locale can cause the displayed selector to remain in the prospect's machine locale while the generated invite uses UTC or a different tz code. DST transitions and older Calendly widgets can make this mismatch more likely for APAC visitors.

Two quick workarounds I can do right away:
- I'll send a manual .ics invite for 10:00 AM AEST (UTC+10) for Monday — that avoids any auto-detect ambiguity.
- For the longer-term fix on our side, we should add an explicit tz query parameter to the Calendly link we send in outbound sequences (example: ?tz=Australia/Sydney) and add a one-line note in the template that says "If your calendar shows a different time, please use the timezone dropdown on the scheduling page or accept the manual invite below."

Internal note to Marissa/Rafael: can we update the sequence in Outreach to attach the tz param for APAC targets and add an ICS fallback for Chili Piper no-shows? See internal doc: https://drive.redwood.com/teams/sales/scheduler-fallbacks.md

John — I'm attaching an invite now for Mon 20 May 2029 10:00 AM AEST. If that doesn't work, reply with two slot options and I'll book manually.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference

Thanks Naomi — good catch. A couple quick ops suggestions:
- Add a small line in the Outreach cadence template (APAC variants) that includes the explicit tz param on the Calendly link and a note about picking a timezone from the top-right selector.
- For high-value targets, enable Chili Piper as a fallback; if the scheduler widget appears inconsistent, our SE can drop a manual ICS from their calendar which preserves the correct TZ.
- I'll open a tiny PR on the templates repo and drop a sample ICS generator snippet (makes it easier for SDRs to attach).

I'll take action on the Outreach template now and ping the ops doc when done.
